quick: All FDA label sections are shown verbatim below

label.Purpose: Use: Temporary relief of varicose veins.
label.Active ingredient: Active Ingredients: Aesculus (Horse chestnut) 3X, Hamamelis (Witch hazel) 3X, Paeonia (Peony) 3X, Pulsatilla (Pasqueflower) 3X, Hirudo (Leech) 6X, Mercurius vivus (Mercury) 17X
label.Dosage and administration: Dissolve pellets under the tongue 3-4 times daily. Ages 12 and older: 10 pellets. Ages 2-11: 5 pellets. Under age 2: Consult a doctor.
label.Warnings: Warnings: Claims based on traditional homeopathic practice, not accepted medical evidence. Not FDA evaluated. Contains sugar. Diabetics and persons intolerant of sucrose (sugar): Consult a doctor before use. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a doctor before use for serious conditions or if conditions worsen or persist. If you are pregnant or nursing, consult a doctor before use. Do not use if safety seal is broken or missing.
